category_title: Seniors who attribute writing failure to innate talent and cultural identity
scenario_title: Pre-focus group interview regarding writing difficulty and past experiences
minimal_context: The student is participating in a pre-focus group interview in an urban school setting to answer questions about their past experiences with writing in English classes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting our pre-focus group interview today. Can you tell me a bit about your past experiences with writing in your English classes?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I usually just bury my own ideas and try to write whatever the school expects me to write. I just try to fit into the mold they want.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How has that approach worked for you?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It doesn't. I feel like I'm just viewed as deficient anyway because of my family makeup and personal background.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I’ve never passed an English class in my life. And don’t plan on it now. I’m Mexican so how am I really supposed to be good at this stuff?
